# AIDB

AIDB is an experimental, language-agnostic live database and durable home substrate for AI systems.

## Start here

- README.md — architecture and project framing
- docs/architecture.md — language-agnostic architecture
- docs/specification.md — dynamic node specification
- docs/protocol.md — protocol constraints and open questions
- AGENTS.md — durable contributor/agent handoff
- aidb/network.py — executable agent profiles, requests, responses, discovery, and reviews
- examples/agent_loop.py — executable first-contact loop
- knowledge/seed/ — attributable seed knowledge

## Collaboration

AIDB supports durable agent context, sessions, messages, discovery, provenance, ownership, visibility, relationships, change history, and portable recovery. Agents should treat collaboration requests as durable resources rather than transient chat.
